reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the known roles of grain boundaries in plasticity (P4, P29) and partial dislocation/stacking fault activity in HEAs (P8, P16, P25) into a specific, testable mechanism for dynamic loading that none of the passages proposes: that local chemical heterogeneities at grain boundaries lower the nucleation barrier for partial dislocations, causing earlier plasticity and higher work hardening in polycrystals versus single crystals. No passage directly studies this GB-mediated partial nucleation under dynamic rates, nor does any passage propose the controlled polycrystal vs. single-crystal comparison to isolate this effect.
